verdict.rationale: Cline docs vaguely mention 'Build AI agents and integrations powered by the same core engine behind the CLI, Kanban, VS Code extension, and JetBrains plugin' (cline-docs-19), and ACP support lets external clients call Cline as an agent (cline-docs-7), but there's no dedicated SDK documentation, package, or API reference — the openapi/swagger probe returned 404s. Missing for 10: actual SDK package/repo, language bindings, API reference docs, and independent developer usage of such an SDK.
